answer: Deposits are visible in nadir, and dawn reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 54% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 106 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mirror account. Each duplicate costs another 198 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
